name: Мат зі звільненням поля або лінії
description:
Time for a new mating tool!
Sometimes you cannot make mate because one of your own pieces is in the way.
If that’s the case, it is smart to move this piece. By doing so, you open access to a file, diagonal or rank.

Study both example 1 and example 2.
In both positions, there are two pieces behind each other on a file (example 1) of diagonal (example 2).
The front piece gives check. And by clearing away, the back piece can take away flight squares next to the king.
This is a real power trick!

What do you have to do?
Checkmate your opponent by letting your pieces cooperate in a clearance action. Make sure that Black cannot get out of check.

examples.text:
Checkmate for Black? Small changes, it would seem. The king has the green squares to flee to. How should white get access to those squares?

Looking closer, you will notice that White’s rook is directed at the green squares!
However, the white knight is in the way.
The front piece (knight) has to clear the file for the back piece (rook).
The knight checks the king. Checkmate!

White has to take away the green flight square.
He clears away the front piece, the knight.
Now the back piece has access to the green square.

The knight can give check in two ways.
It is not smart to move to the red square. Black’s pawn can capture there.
The knight should follow the green arrow: checkmate!

texts: Check the king while covering all escape squares. That's checkmate!
